Chapter 50: Chapter 47: Star-Destroying Level

Chapter 50: Chapter 47: Star-destroying Level

The Cosmic Human Alliance’s three ultimate intelligent goddesses are known as the Goddess of Freedom, the Goddess of Justice, and the Goddess of Wisdom.

These three goddesses govern different aspects.

The Goddess of Freedom oversees aggression and expansion.

The Goddess of Justice handles legal decisions.

The Goddess of Wisdom is in charge of civilian life and logistics.

The three goddesses each fulfill their roles, collectively supporting the dazzling brilliance of human civilization today.

Normally, each goddess would only appear in their respective fields.

...

Only when an event occurs that could impact the star domain, or even beyond, do the three goddesses communicate and make decisions together.

“Song Wuyang has seen the three goddesses,”

Song Wuyang speculated uneasily, speaking with a hint of respect.

Although the three goddesses don’t possess what are called emotions, and they don’t treat citizens differently based on their attitude.

But in front of these three, it’s always safe to be a bit more respectful.

“Changes have been detected in the Martial Path Evolutionary Path,”

the Goddess of Wisdom said with a solemn and cool voice, being the first to speak.

“The Martial Path Evolutionary Path?”

Song Wuyang was stunned.

He did know about the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

He even had a strong impression of this evolutionary path.

But for the three goddesses to seek him out because of this?

The Martial Path Evolutionary Path is special, but its theoretical limit was already set.

Third Rank.

Was such a level of evolutionary path worthy of startling the three goddesses all at once?

Could it be that the theoretical limit of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had changed, rising by a rank?

Song Wuyang thought to himself, silently speculating.

The theoretical limits of evolutionary paths are deduced by the three goddesses using their tremendous computational power.

Simply put,

a Second Layer evolutionary path, if its theoretical limit is Third Layer, then it means this path potentially could reach the Third Layer.

Of course, this is only a possibility.

Most evolutionary paths do not reach their theoretical limits.

But it’s undeniable that the theoretical limits derived by the three goddesses are somewhat linked to the potential of the evolutionary path.

Moreover, the deductions of the goddesses are not entirely accurate.

During the development of evolutionary paths, they can be influenced by various factors.

For example, a First Rank path evolving towards Second Layer could, under certain special influences, see its potential greatly increase, raising its theoretical limit.

Although these are low probability events, now that all three goddesses have approached him and mentioned changes in the determination of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path,

Song Wuyang could only think in this direction.

“This is the latest determination result of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path,”

the somber voice of Goddess of Wisdom came again.

At the same time,

a virtual screen appeared in front of Song Wuyang.

It displayed many characters, describing the ‘Martial Canon.’

Song Wuyang immediately looked towards the ‘Theoretical Limit’ section.

“Sixth Rank.”

Song Wuyang was stunned, almost thinking that he had read it wrong.

He looked again.

It was still Sixth Rank.

“Goddess, is this?”

Song Wuyang wanted to ask if the goddess had made a mistake,

only to suddenly realize that it wasn’t just the Goddess of Wisdom watching him; the other two goddesses were also present.

He swiftly tucked away that comment in his mind.

As ultimate intelligences of the Cosmic Human Civilization, every action of the goddesses is computed millions of times over.

They are definitely not mistaken.

Especially when it concerns the Sixth Rank.

Moreover, it wasn’t just the Goddess of Wisdom who had come today.

All three goddesses were here, clearly after countless confirmations prior to their visit.

“How is this possible…”

Song Wuyang muttered to himself.

The Martial Path Evolutionary Path, which had a theoretical limit of Third Rank just six months ago.

Now suddenly had a theoretical limit of Sixth Rank.

Skipping three ranks in one go, this was rarified among dozens of star domains nearby.

“The ‘Celestial Phenomena Chapter’ and ‘Yin and Yang Chapter’ of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path involve the fusion and transformation of extreme forces.”

“Continue to develop and explore, and there is a one hundred percent chance of reaching the Third Rank, a sixty percent chance of reaching the Fourth Rank, a thirty percent chance of reaching the Fifth Rank, and a ten percent chance of reaching the Sixth Rank,” the Goddess of Wisdom said.

“Extreme force fusion…”

Song Wuyang took a deep breath.

Fusion of the same type of forces could already cause major issues.

Not to mention the fusion of extreme forces, which had a high probability of causing a self-explosion.

Suddenly, Song Wuyang’s curiosity surged about what the founder of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path had gone through to delve into these realms.

Unfortunately, Song Wuyang knew the only thing he could be now was curious about Lin Yuan.

The evolution path that was established reached the theoretical Sixth Rank, and now that creator of Martial Tao was probably the favored gem of the Goddess of Wisdom.

It was likely that not even the lords of the stars had the authority to investigate this person, let alone himself.

“What can I do now?”

After a moment of silence, Song Wuyang spoke up.

“According to the judgment, the subsequent ‘Celestial Phenomena Chapter’ and ‘Yin and Yang Chapter’ of the Martial Canon are valued at twenty thousand Merit Points and require authorization from Official Song Wuyang,” said the Goddess of Wisdom succinctly.

“Twenty thousand Merit Points…” Song Wuyang felt somewhat bitter.

He had battled various different species on the front lines, killing countless to barely elevate his citizen rank to Fourth Level.

Then he was reassigned to the rear to serve as an Official.

Just the rewards he could earn as an Official, even over a thousand years, would not amount to twenty thousand Merit Points.

That was under the condition of receiving a superior evaluation from the Goddess of Wisdom every ten years.

But Song Wuyang also knew that an evolutionary path with a theoretical potential of Sixth Rank truly deserved that many Merit Points.

Not to mention, just the fusion of two extreme forces had failed countless times, each failure resulting in tremendous losses.

“I agree,” Song Wuyang nodded.

In fact, it wouldn’t matter if he disagreed.

The three goddesses would authorize it step by step, and the result wouldn’t change.

Shuiyue Residential Complex.

Underground training ground.

Lin Yuan was sitting cross-legged.

Waiting patiently for a response from the Goddess of Wisdom.

In his heart, Lin Yuan believed that the insights gathered from this journey through the ‘Celestial Phenomena Chapter’ and ‘Yin and Yang Chapter’ were more valuable than the ‘Grandmaster Chapter,’ ‘Great Grandmaster Chapter,’ ‘Mythological Chapter,’ and ‘Carefree Chapter.’

Even when Lin Yuan encountered bottlenecks while exploring the latter, he surpassed them in days or months at most.

But the ‘Yin and Yang Chapter’… To comprehend the Yin Yang Power, Lin Yuan had deliberated for nearly ten years, even with the aid of the True Martial Sword.

Lin Yuan’s thoughts were turbulent.

Just then,

A solemn and cold voice came through.

“Respected Second Layer Citizen Lin Yuan, the evaluation of your submitted Martial Path Evolutionary Path has been completed.”

“All right,” Lin Yuan was invigorated.

Although Lin Yuan had expended a great deal of effort on the ‘Yin and Yang Chapter’, the specific value it held in the eyes of the Goddess of Wisdom was unknown.

“Citizen Lin Yuan, according to our evaluation, the subsequent evolutionary path is valued at twenty thousand Merit Points. Would you like it credited now?”

“Twenty thousand Merit Points.” Lin Yuan breathed a sigh of relief.

Considering that one thousand Merit Points could generate one Second Layer Citizen, twenty thousand Merit Points could create twenty Second Layer Citizens.

Twenty Second Layer Citizens?

In the entirety of Dongning City, there were only six or seven.

“Go ahead,” Lin Yuan said.

After confirming the twenty thousand Merit Points were credited,

Lin Yuan suddenly became curious to know the current evaluation of the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

“Theoretical upper limit of Sixth Rank?”

Lin Yuan checked the latest information on the Martial Path Evolutionary Path.

He was somewhat surprised.

Sixth Rank… corresponding to a Sixth Rank Evolver.

And Sixth Rank Evolvers had another name.

That was Fallen Star Level.

Every Sixth Rank Evolver was capable of traversing the cosmos with their physical body alone, and with a full-force strike, they could obliterate stars.
